question: Which chapter concludes in the Vāstuśāstra text Prāsādamaṇḍana composed by Sūtradhāra Maṇḍana?
premises: The text is attributed to Śrī Sūtradhāra Maṇḍana.
The work is identified as Vāstuśāstra Prāsādamaṇḍana.
inference: This marks the conclusion of the eighth chapter of Prāsādamaṇḍana.
plain_english: Thus ends the eighth chapter in the Prāsādamaṇḍana, a Vāstuśāstra composed by Śrī Sūtradhāra Maṇḍana.
